phone.changelog: v3.3.48: Movies fixed — movibox streams routed through VPS proxy (CDN rejects headerless video requests).

tv.changelog: v3.12.73: Movies & series fixed — movibox CDN hotlink gate (429) handled: native player now sends Referer/UA headers; web/phone playback streams through the VPS proxy. Live channel thumbnails fixed — dead Sony logos repaired, logos served via image proxy with retry. Live channel playback untouched.

android_tv.changelog: v3.12.80: Player controls collapsed into ONE small corner Options icon — LEFT/RIGHT now always seek (the pause/play strip no longer traps navigation), DOWN closes the panel, UP/MENU opens it. OTT icons fixed — all provider logos re-pointed to live TMDB images (probed 200) with a brand-color fallback tile so no icon ever renders empty. Movies/Series categories un-mixed — type now comes from the item itself, not the feed bucket. Addon catalogs load in parallel. Cache-clear now also sweeps provider/live/mirror keys.
